target_description: 已完成日盘收盘后，联合预测未来1–5个观测交易日内首次未来超阈值的累计概率。ATM隐波或凸性违反代理任一日最大值超过预测日前最近60个完整交易日（至少20日）95%分位即为事件；阈值在预测原点冻结。当前正常与已异常状态分开建模。所有期限共享一条离散时间风险率曲线，累计概率为1−∏(1−风险率)。这是曲面异常代理，不是持仓亏损概率或VaR。观测交易日不是官方交易所日历。

onset.definition: 当前两项曲面代理均未超阈值，预测未来窗口内首次出现超阈值。

persistence.definition: 当前至少一项代理已超阈值，预测未来窗口内再次/继续出现超阈值；不代表连续异常持续时长，也不是恢复时间预测。

base_training.calibration: same shared hazard-logit intercept for every candidate on independent calibration block; no horizon-wise calibration
base_training.selection: per task/symbol minimum mean Brier over the complete five-horizon curve on validation only; ties prefer baseline then uniform logistic
base_training.threshold: per-task/symbol/horizon validation-only F1; baseline rates do not issue predictive alerts
base_training.censoring: exclude whole origin unless all five future sessions are complete and contiguous
base_training.preprocessing: train-only median/IQR, clipping at 8; binary indicator scale 1
base_training.quality_gate: same whole-curve missingness/dynamic RAW feature OOD fraction >.35 for all candidates; separately withhold any selected RAW feature departure from collapsed training 99% bounds (rtol 1e-6, atol 1e-8)

fixed_parameters.calibration: independent task affine hazard-logit plus shrunk symbol offsets; all candidates equally treated
fixed_parameters.blend_space: conditional hazard probabilities before survival product
fixed_parameters.selection: pooled per task; maximize paired validation mean Brier gain minus one nonoverlapping 10-date-block standard error; positive margin required; ties prefer baseline/smaller weight/uniform model
fixed_parameters.threshold: task-pooled validation F1; baseline does not issue predictive alerts

fixed_parameters.origin_eligibility: complete five-session label window for every horizon
fixed_parameters.split_purge: all splits use label_end_5 strictly before the next boundary
fixed_parameters.candidate_selection: past validation only; no fold/test-driven parameter changes
fixed_parameters.bootstrap_method: paired circular moving blocks of global observed dates; all symbols retained together

base_training.calibration: same shared hazard-logit intercept for every candidate on independent calibration block; no horizon-wise calibration
base_training.selection: per task/symbol minimum mean Brier over the complete five-horizon curve on validation only; ties prefer baseline then uniform logistic
base_training.threshold: per-task/symbol/horizon validation-only F1; baseline rates do not issue predictive alerts
base_training.censoring: exclude whole origin unless all five future sessions are complete and contiguous
base_training.preprocessing: train-only median/IQR, clipping at 8; binary indicator scale 1
base_training.quality_gate: same whole-curve missingness/dynamic RAW feature OOD fraction >.35 for all candidates; separately withhold any selected RAW feature departure from collapsed training 99% bounds (rtol 1e-6, atol 1e-8)

model.calibration: independent task affine hazard-logit plus shrunk symbol offsets; all candidates equally treated
model.blend_space: conditional hazard probabilities before survival product
model.selection: pooled per task; maximize paired validation mean Brier gain minus one nonoverlapping 10-date-block standard error; positive margin required; ties prefer baseline/smaller weight/uniform model
model.threshold: task-pooled validation F1; baseline does not issue predictive alerts
